chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Ali ibn Yaqteen who said:
I asked the Abd al-Salih (peace be upon him) about the woman who dies while her child is in her belly. He said: 'Her belly is split open and her child is extracted.'

key_terms.الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ: The Abd al-Salih (title for Imam Musa al-Kadhim, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling for a pregnant woman who dies while her child is still alive in her womb?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the foundational juristic principle of 'opening the womb' (fath al-batin) to preserve the life of a viable fetus when the mother dies. It highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the distinct legal status of the fetus as a separate entity entitled to life, a ruling derived from the Imam's direct instruction to physically extract the child to ensure its survival.
